ns2:course.label: Urban Informatics II
ns2:course.description: Provides an introduction to formal methods for collecting and analyzing data required in various planning processes. Methods include survey research, regional demographic and economic analysis, forecasting techniques, benefit-cost analysis, and decision analysis. Prerequisite: UP 116 or an introductory statistics course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: UP 116 or an introductory statistics course.
